notes.title: Beta(Demo) Version Patch Note #1
notes.content:
[h3]-Mobile[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a memory leak in 64Bit Android devices.
[/list]

[h3]-Spectator Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to stop playing when a spectating player surrendered.
[*]Fixed a bug that players spectating gained experience.
[*]Fixed a bug where the end message was not displayed to players watching when the game was over.
[*]Fixed a bug where the card was not visible immediately after entering the spectator.
[/list]

[h3]-Reconnection[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the card was not visible immediately after reconnecting to the game.
[/list]

[h3]-Play with friend[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could invite a friendly match while the opponent is playing.
[*] It's now impossible to invite a friendly match to a friend who is in the acceptance / rejection screen.
[/list]

[h3]-Game play[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that the game completion UI did not disappear when playing again after completing the game.
[*] Guidance messages are now displayed only when they are available for interaction ("Please select a deck", etc.)
[/list]

[h3]-Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now cancel the match queue.
[*] You can now cancel your friendly application.
[/list]

[h3]-Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the "Sacrifice" card of "Warlock" hero not to destroy 2 of my decks.
[/list]

You can play the beta version until the official opening by downloading 'Beta Version' on the Lucky Heroes store page. Thanks!
